name: project-gutenberg-outline
description: Hierarchical outline and timeline scrubber for Project Gutenberg

scripts.lint:ext: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist-firefox
scripts.pack:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist-firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:ext && npm run pack:firefox
